statusNote: BM-001 standalone preview-session POST is fixed. Root cause was (1) the runtime preview-session service awaited the PowerShell-based PDF conversion (Word COM / LibreOffice fallback) synchronously and unbounded, so the request could hang past Playwright's 30s waitForResponse; (2) the preview-session spec did not click 'Dữ liệu demo' before clicking 'Xem trước bản in', so the workspace short-circuited with a missing-required-fields error and never fired the POST. Fix: race the PDF conversion against a bounded budget (default 8000ms, override via QLLAW_RUNTIME_PREVIEW_PDF_BUDGET_MS); the DOCX is the primary deliverable and `pdfPreviewUrl: null` plus an honest 'Đã tạo file DOCX tạm thời' indicator is the supported fallback. Test spec updated to click 'Dữ liệu demo' first so the locked-contract requiredFieldKeys gate is satisfied before the preview-session POST.
